verification_name: Step 2: Order Reservation TTL Expiration & Fencing Verification

remediated_defects.fix_description: Stored active reservation's own ttl_seconds and expires_at_epoch in _pending_reservation. Decoupled expiration evaluation from incoming caller's TTL parameter.
commit_order_reservation() validates that now_epoch < expires_at_epoch. Rejects commit and clears expired reservation even if no competing worker requested the slot.
Introduced self._reservation_generation persisted in state schema. Each new reservation increments generation. Preempted worker cannot commit after generation advances.

In open_simulated_trade(), position assignment self.open_position = pos occurs strictly after commit_order_reservation() returns True. On commit failure, fees/slippage are rolled back and state remains unmutated.
